strict_scale_note: Synthesis-only infrastructure module: no deployment/runtime service is required by the task idea, so strict LOC/resource counts are treated as diagnostics while preserving coupled VPC behavior coverage.
production_characteristics: CDK module emits native CloudFormation resources rather than an ad hoc JSON report
network tiers interact through route tables, NAT topology, endpoints, ACLs, and outputs
validation blocks unsafe or impossible network intent before synthesis
configuration mutations change synthesized resource topology deterministically

root_cause_clusters.RC1_SUBNET_TIER_MODEL: The starter treats only public/private tiers as first-class and drops database/intra topology.
root_cause_clusters.RC2_ADDRESSING_VALIDATION: The starter accepts CIDR and AZ inputs without enforcing containment, overlap, or NAT coverage.
root_cause_clusters.RC3_NAT_ROUTING: The starter does not model shared vs per-AZ NAT routing or database isolation.
root_cause_clusters.RC4_IPV6_EGRESS: The starter omits Amazon-provided IPv6 assignment and egress-only private routing.
root_cause_clusters.RC5_ENDPOINT_SCOPE: The starter omits gateway/interface endpoints and service/tier validation.
root_cause_clusters.RC6_GUARDRAILS_OBSERVABILITY: The starter omits network ACLs and flow-log delivery resources.
root_cause_clusters.RC7_DETERMINISM_OUTPUTS: The starter does not expose the stable outputs and logical naming expected by downstream reviewers.

defects.observable_failure: database subnet tier is absent from the synthesized template
defects.partial_fix_trap: Adding database subnets alone still leaves route isolation and endpoint table selection wrong.

defects.observable_failure: intra subnet tier is absent from the synthesized template
defects.partial_fix_trap: Adding intra subnets without isolated route tables leaks tier semantics.

defects.observable_failure: tier and AZ tags are incomplete for every subnet family
defects.partial_fix_trap: Fixing tags on public subnets leaves private/database endpoint selection opaque.

defects.observable_failure: overlapping subnet CIDRs synthesize successfully
defects.partial_fix_trap: Only comparing adjacent configured subnets misses overlaps after configuration reordering.

defects.observable_failure: subnets outside primary or secondary VPC CIDR boundaries synthesize successfully
defects.partial_fix_trap: Checking only the primary CIDR blocks legitimate secondary-CIDR subnets.

defects.observable_failure: unknown subnet tiers are accepted and silently misrouted
defects.partial_fix_trap: Rejecting unknown subnet tiers still leaves endpoint tiers unchecked.

defects.observable_failure: per-AZ NAT mode accepts an AZ with private subnets but no public subnet
defects.partial_fix_trap: A single-NAT implementation can mask missing per-AZ coverage.

defects.observable_failure: no NAT gateways are synthesized for private subnet egress
defects.partial_fix_trap: Creating NAT gateways without route table wiring leaves private subnets dark.

defects.observable_failure: private default routes do not target same-AZ NAT gateways
defects.partial_fix_trap: Routing every private table to the first NAT fails AZ-failure isolation.

defects.observable_failure: single NAT mode does not collapse private default routes onto one NAT
defects.partial_fix_trap: Hardcoding one NAT breaks the default per-AZ topology.

defects.observable_failure: database subnets receive internet default routes despite isolated intent
defects.partial_fix_trap: Removing all database routes breaks explicitly enabled database NAT mode.

defects.observable_failure: Amazon-provided IPv6 VPC CIDR block is missing
defects.partial_fix_trap: Adding the VPC block without subnet CIDRs produces unusable IPv6 subnets.

defects.observable_failure: public subnets do not route IPv6 traffic through the internet gateway
defects.partial_fix_trap: Adding only public IPv6 leaves private egress semantics incomplete.

defects.observable_failure: private subnets do not route IPv6 egress through an egress-only internet gateway
defects.partial_fix_trap: Using an internet gateway for private IPv6 breaks the isolation model.

defects.observable_failure: gateway endpoints are not synthesized
defects.partial_fix_trap: Creating endpoints without route table filtering attaches storage paths to public or intra tiers.

defects.observable_failure: gateway endpoint unsupported services are accepted
defects.partial_fix_trap: Validating gateway services does not validate interface service names.

defects.observable_failure: interface endpoints are not synthesized
defects.partial_fix_trap: Creating interface endpoints without private DNS changes application endpoint resolution.

defects.observable_failure: interface endpoint security group is missing TLS-only CIDR ingress
defects.partial_fix_trap: A permissive security group passes connectivity but violates the safety contract.

defects.observable_failure: tier-specific network ACLs are not synthesized
defects.partial_fix_trap: Creating ACLs without associations leaves subnets on the default ACL.

defects.observable_failure: configured NACL entries are not materialized
defects.partial_fix_trap: Ingress-only entries miss egress safety behavior.

defects.observable_failure: VPC flow log resource is absent
defects.partial_fix_trap: FlowLog without IAM/log group cannot deliver CloudWatch events.

defects.observable_failure: flow-log IAM policy can use wildcard log permissions
defects.partial_fix_trap: Narrowing actions without the log stream resource suffix breaks delivery.

defects.observable_failure: database and intra subnet outputs are absent
defects.partial_fix_trap: Subnet outputs alone do not expose route table IDs needed by endpoint consumers.

defects.observable_failure: gateway endpoint IDs are absent from stack outputs
defects.partial_fix_trap: Endpoint resources become hard to consume across stacks despite synthesis passing.

defects.observable_failure: logical IDs and output names drift between synth runs or config ordering
defects.partial_fix_trap: Sorting only tags does not stabilize construct IDs derived from unordered maps.
